scope: Descriptive duration attribution of every V30 first-offer action and all retained V29 pairs; no refit or policy change.
interpretation: In the retained V29 board/target paths, all first-path groups are route-specific with at least 116/182 observations. The broad duration grouping understates these particular paths. Same-stop training means are closer to these realized durations, making segment heterogeneity a concrete candidate; the matched groups contain as few as 3/7 records. On all first-offer paths, compare only common actual durations and completely matched training paths; retain the unmatched paths and per-path minimum group counts. This elapsed-duration comparison does not condition a new probability model, rescore full action costs or measure policy benefit. These development comparisons do not identify recovery versus segment versus time effects, validate a new conditional model, or establish a controller improvement. Target realized departure delays are outcome labels, not publicly available selection inputs.
